entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference. The whole interface is very confusing. Frankly, it's just hard to use and I expected more from it. I've already read the user manual and it didn't help. I just want to return it.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear that the experience wasn't what you were hoping for. Let me just pull up your order details to check the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Alright, I have your order here. I see the delivery was made 12 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.

Okay, yes. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. You are unfortunately outside that timeframe, so I can go ahead and process that return for you immediately.
Great. Just email me the shipping label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply attach it to the original packaging and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund once we process the return, typically within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
